name: webyansh-a11y-scan
//triggers: Hourly. Webflow Cloud provisions D1/KV/R2 but exposes no cron trigger, so
the clock lives in this worker and the monitor data lives in the app.
Hourly is the finest granularity any schedule needs (the shortest is daily)
and it means a monitor that comes due is picked up within the hour rather
than waiting for a fixed daily tick.
//vars: Not a secret — it is a public staging URL, so it lives in versioned config
rather than in `wrangler secret`, where nobody could see what it was set to.
The shared secret that authenticates the call is still a secret.
